headline: Veteran Australian actress Margaret Ellison dies aged 84
body: Margaret Ellison, the stage and screen actress who won fans across five decades, has died aged 84, her family said in a statement on Monday. She died peacefully at home in Melbourne after a short illness. Ellison began her career in theatre in the 1960s before appearing in a long-running television drama and several feature films. Colleagues paid tribute to her warmth and generosity on set. The family has asked for privacy and said details of a memorial service will be shared in due course.
